Every LK and Veam needs a socket. Open a DB, and find the table Couple LK's and Veams to sockets.
Automatic fills the sockets in order. Or choose a socket yourself, a loose spider, or do not patch.
One button returns everything to automatic.
Now an important rule. LK and Veam cables are short. A socket in one rack can only feed nodes in the same rack. Here the panels are in one rack, and the nodes in another.
Only network cables can run from rack to rack. Two racks that stand directly on top of each other count as one: that is the tick, stacked on the rack above.
Without that tick, the LK's have no node in their own rack. PatchLab warns, and offers a Fix button.
Press Fix, and the racks are stacked. Everything is patched again.
A node without a rack always comes with a spider. Add a loose node, and an LK spider is added with it, because a loose node has no panel to be fed from.
